svg.title: Apophis preliminary PDS Model B: three body-frame orthographic projections
svg.desc: A deterministic SVG polygon rendering of the supplied 2000-vertex, 3996-facet Apophis shape mesh. Reconstruction, not a photograph; body frame, not predicted 2029 attitude.
svg.text: Apophis — preliminary PDS Model B (Brozovic et al. 2018)
Reconstruction, not a photograph · body frame; not predicted 2029 attitude
PDS: (99942) Apophis 3-D radar shape model · 2,000 vertices · 3,996 triangular facets · all projections share one scale
Shape source: NASA PDS radar model, Model B; vertices/facets in km. No rotation, trajectory or attitude prediction is applied.
Dimensions describe this mesh; shape remains uncertain.
